clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire Town Hall, Bailiff Conacher keeps Stormwind law in force under Magistrate Solomon. He relies on travelers to uphold local decrees across the embattled Redridge Mountains.

Bailiff Conacher works with Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire Town Hall to uphold law across the Redridge Mountains. Blackrock orcs and local gnolls besiege the town, leaving Conacher without ordinary civic procedures or royal garrisons to rely on. He issues legal decrees that authorize passing travelers to carry out capital justice in the realm's name.

When the dark mage Morganth took the Tower of Ilgalar and bent the local Shadowhide gnolls to his will, the Court of Lakeshire judged the beasts guilty of high treason. Stormwind law sentences those who aid a fugitive and criminal to death. Conacher invokes Solomon's Law and sends travelers across the ridges to find Shadowhide gnolls and bring back their pendants as proof that the crown's law has been carried out.
